focus: District of Columbia (Downtown, Foggy Bottom, Georgetown, Adams Morgan, Shaw, Columbia Heights, NoMa, H Street NE, Capitol Hill, Navy Yard, The Wharf, Fort Lincoln, Cleveland Park, Tenleytown, Palisades, Chevy Chase DC, Takoma, and Brightwood Park)
intro: This first Washington, DC page covers private mailbox stores inside the District whose own public pages list an address, staffed hours, and package acceptance — two independent pack-and-ship stores (H Street NE and Georgia Avenue NW) whose mailbox pages say boxholders get 24-hour access, plus eighteen UPS Store locations from The Wharf and Capitol Hill up to Georgetown, Tenleytown, and Takoma, most of them open on Sundays. It is not a complete metro inventory; Arlington, Alexandria, Bethesda, Silver Spring, and other Maryland and Virginia suburbs are not covered yet. 24-hour lobby access is flagged only when the store’s own page says so. The UPS Store pages mention 24-hour access only at participating locations, so that flag is off for those stores. Box availability can change; treat it as something to confirm. If you cannot get to a storefront, compare virtual mailbox services.

listings.name: Gold Spot Pack and Ship
listings.area: Washington · H Street NE (Near Northeast / Atlas District)

hours.notes: Staffed store hours as shown on the mailbox rental page for November 22–28, 2026. The same page says mailbox customers have 24-hour access to a brightly lit, secure mailbox area.

listings.carriersNotes: The mailbox rental page says the store accepts packages and mail from the Post Office, UPS, FedEx, DHL, and couriers.
listings.visitNotes: The mailbox rental page says mailbox customers have 24-hour access to a brightly lit, secure mailbox area, and offers call-ahead mail check, email or text notification, and mail forwarding. It does not say whether packages too large for a box can be picked up after staffed hours. Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.

listings.name: The UPS Store — 996 Maine Ave SW

hours.notes: Staffed store hours from the official location page’s opening-hours data. Holiday hours can differ; the page lists Thanksgiving Day (November 26) as closed.

listings.carriersNotes: The official mailbox-services page for this store says mailbox customers get package acceptance from all carriers, plus mail holding and forwarding. It does not list carrier names. Confirm any size or signing limits with the store.
listings.visitNotes: The mailbox-services page lists “24-hour access (at participating locations),” which does not confirm after-hours lobby access at this store. Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.
